name: talent-one
description: One role brief in, a full hiring package out. A per-role Context Pack, nine artifact specialists, a scout that builds the pack, a REFUTE critic and a QA gate on the verifier tier, and an orchestrator that runs the loop. Rendered deterministically as branded HTML with sourced market data. Also carries an Oracle funnel diagnosis with a scripted answer key, a Prompt Forge helper, and a headless runner. Built from the talent-one module of onepromptman/talentai; the paste-in and n8n swarm editions of the roster are published separately as onepromptman/dag-talent-agents.
